skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Holiday HD08
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD08. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
skins.quote: You can always meet new friends at the beach.

skins.name: Wasteland Walker
skins.content: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Wasteland Walker. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for adapting to all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
skins.quote: Treading through myriad wildernesses, all to track down a past vision recalled.
